history.recommendation_text: 42. The Board recommends that the Administration review the procurement process in order to implement a simplified and more nimble process, while it clarifies and updates the procurement framework.
history.reference_raw: A/73/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the year; para. 373
history.administration_response: The Administration has reviewed its procurement processes and identified several areas that can be streamlined and allow for more flexibility in the context of management reform and achieving the goal of a more agile, nimble supply chain. The resulting changes have been reflected in the updated Procurement Manual, which was issued in early October 2019. The manual now offers, among other things, shortened timelines for tender posting periods, the elimination of duplicative review processes and strengthened provisions on contract management and the settlement of claims.
history.board_assessment: The Administration has changed and clarified several aspects of the process. The Board holds that the Administration should continue the review in order to introduce further guidance or policy changes. The recommendation is considered implemented.
